verdict.rationale: Wave documents automatic bank-transaction import into bookkeeping on the Pro Plan. Its own built-in invoicing and payments are stated to be connected to the accounting feature. Payroll is a native Wave product, but no evidence says payroll activity posts to the ledger automatically, and nothing shows connecting third-party payment processors or payroll systems. Missing for 10: documented automatic payroll-to-ledger posting, integrations with external payment and payroll systems, bank feeds on the free tier, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts in seconds with the Pro Plan. Transactions will appear in your bookkeeping automatically
With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
Your invoicing and payment information are connected to Wave's accounting feature, helping you stay organized.
